meta.name: Sara Woman in the Shadows
meta.description: The suspicious death of her son pushes a former secret agent back into action, investigating a series of crimes that grows increasingly sinister.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After the suspicious death of her estranged son Giorgio, ex-secret agent Sara reconnects with her former team and the life she left behind years earlier.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Teresa pushes Sara to follow Sergio's last steps and solve his disappearance. Pardo rivals the former secret agent and doesn't trust her.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: An illegal farm worker claims responsibility for a double murder, but Sara and Pardo suspect something's off — especially when a politician intervenes.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Sara and Pardo pursue a determined but elusive journalist. Teresa confronts lies from her last lover while worrying about the future of the unit.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A new disappearance sets Sara in motion. A face from the past gives her the chance to settle some old scores, but she's unwilling to risk Viola's safety.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The election campaign is nearing its end. While tracking a friend of Tarallo, Sara and Pardo uncover something bigger than expected.
